_about: Era targets for engine/master.py (`--target <name>`), measured with tools/refcurve.py and added with `refcurve.py add`: a 1/3-octave curve in dB re 1 kHz on master.py's bands (only the shape matters: the master lays it over the mix at its level around 1 kHz), with provenance: method, source, era, n (tracks), date, the spread per band (interquartile range of the tracks, from the Bark band holding the band's centre), the fit residual, the loudness estimate and the Bark-band medians the curve was fitted to. Catalogue curves come from open data (MusicBrainz + AcousticBrainz, CC0; no audio) and are interim: the definitive targets are reference masters measured locally (`refcurve.py measure`; docs/PRODUCTION.md 'Era-appropriate targets'). Built-in curves in master.py (beat, hiphop, trance, rock, *_handtuned) are never replaced. Method and validation: docs/MASTERING.md 'Era targets'.

trance_2015.source: MusicBrainz tag trance, first release 2015-2021, up to 300 per year; AcousticBrainz low-level Bark bands (CC0)

fit.bands_fitted: 0-20.5 kHz (Bark bands 1-27; under 32 Hz at half weight; 15.5-20.5 kHz at half weight on the lossless files' median, or not fitted when fewer than 20 are lossless)
fit.note: 31.5-40 Hz rest on one Bark band (32-97 Hz), the unreliable band under 32 Hz and the smoothness term (about +-3 dB); 16 kHz rests on the lossless files (about +-2 dB)

trance_2015.note: trance of 2015-2021 (uplifting, progressive, psy and vocal trance under one tag); the default of --genre trance and trance_radio since 2026-11-25. Brighter top (+2 to +5.5 dB at 8-12.5 kHz than the trance curve) must come from tonal content, not boosted noise

trance_2018.note: the 2018-2026 sub-eras of modern trance (docs/TRANCE.md 'Modern trance production', C continued and D): measured 2018-2021, the last years with AcousticBrainz data; 2022-2026 extrapolated. Against a 2015-2017 refit (415 tracks): +1.4 to +1.6 dB at 32-183 Hz, top within 0.4 dB; against trance_2015 (pooled 2015-2021): +1 to +1.5 dB at 50-200 Hz, 0.5 dB darker at 1.25-10 kHz. Use with --genre trance --target trance_2018
